text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here it is! It's finally here! The gateway race of spring,
the stepping stone to the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. Do you know
what the 'Dragon Gate' actually means?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In ancient China, it's said that if a carp
swims up a waterfall, it transforms into a dragon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In other words! If I can climb up here safely, I'll turn into a dragon too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today I'm not Matikanefukukitaru,
I'm Matikanekoinobori! That's how it is!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Higher than the roo-o-of, the koinobori fly~!
The big black carp is—Iwashimizu~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Singing at the top of my lungs really fired me up! I'll climb right
up that waterfall and make a splash all the way to the goal!
